enchantment.volyera.abysswalker.desc: Swim at full speed and mine normally while submerged. Cannot be combined with Frost Walker or Depth Strider.
enchantment.volyera.bulwark.desc: Increases armour toughness and knockback resistance. Cannot be combined with Colossus.
enchantment.volyera.colossus.desc: Grants bonus hearts, armour and knockback resistance. Rare, and cannot be combined with Bulwark.
enchantment.volyera.curse_of_anchoring.d: Slows you, pulls you down and cannot be removed once worn. Found only as treasure.
enchantment.volyera.curse_of_frailty.des: Softens your armour and quietly eats its durability over time. Found only as treasure.
enchantment.volyera.emberheart.desc: Greatly reduces fire damage, shortens how long you burn, and sets melee attackers alight at the cost of durability. Cannot be combined with the Protection family.
enchantment.volyera.featherstep.desc: Increases safe fall distance, reduces fall damage and protects against it. Cannot be combined with Springstep.
enchantment.volyera.gilded_aegis.desc: A treasure enchantment granting armour toughness, knockback resistance, bonus hearts and luck all at once.
enchantment.volyera.glacial_ward.desc: Immunity to freezing damage, extra protection in powder snow, and a chance to slow anything that strikes you.
enchantment.volyera.keeneye.desc: Extends your block and entity interaction range. Helmet only.
enchantment.volyera.momentum.desc: Grants a stacking speed bonus once you are already moving quickly. Leggings only.
enchantment.volyera.prosperity.desc: Increases your luck, improving drops from blocks and mobs.
enchantment.volyera.rejuvenation.desc: Periodically grants a short burst of regeneration while worn.
enchantment.volyera.shadowstride.desc: Moves you faster while sneaking and negates slowdown from blocks like soul sand. Leggings only.
enchantment.volyera.springstep.desc: Makes you bouncy, raises step height and improves jump strength. Uses 26.2's bounciness attribute. Cannot be combined with Featherstep.
enchantment.volyera.stormwarden.desc: Immunity to lightning, heavy protection during thunderstorms, and a speed boost while the storm rages.
enchantment.volyera.thornmail.desc: A chance to wound melee attackers for thorns damage, wearing your armour down as it does. Cannot be combined with Vanguard.
enchantment.volyera.tidewarden.desc: Grants immunity to drowning, extra breath and faster swimming. Helmet only.
enchantment.volyera.vanguard.desc: Grants bonus armour and a chance to weaken melee attackers. Chestplate only, and cannot be combined with Thornmail.
enchantment.volyera.warding.desc: Reduces most incoming damage and stiffens your armour against heavy hits. Cannot be combined with the Protection family.
